inline_text:
## Outcome
A reference document that maps observability boundaries (Agent→Skill, Skill→Tool, Agent→Agent, Agent→MCP server, Agent→A2A peer, Agent→Gateway/Runtime) against what should be observable at each one (identity, context, relationship, lifecycle, outcome, provenance, security, timing) — and flags which existing standards already cover each gap versus which are still open.

## Workstream
WG-level deliverable, with a likely follow-on into external standards coordination (OTel GenAI SIG and/or an A2A extension proposal) depending on feedback.

## Owner
needs owner

## Status
scoping

## Next Step
Share the draft matrix with WG leads for a first round of feedback (message drafted, not yet sent). Collect input on missing boundaries/properties before drafting a formal version.

## Review or Decision Needed
- Do WG leads agree these are the right boundaries, or is a category missing?
- Are the flagged gaps (decision provenance, downscoped auth on delegation) actually unsolved, or is someone already handling this elsewhere?
- Decide whether this becomes a standalone reference doc, a WG deliverable, or an input to an external standards effort.

## Links


## Acceptance Criteria
- Matrix reviewed by at least [N] WG leads
- No unresolved objection that a boundary or property is missing
- Clear decision recorded on next step (standalone doc / WG deliverable / standards submission)

## Notes
Originated as an internal exploration, not yet a formal proposal. Structure is expected to change based on feedback — this issue tracks getting it to a reviewed state, not locking it in.

This reference doc is one possible output of the broader gap-analysis work — other candidate outputs (not yet scoped) include a context-propagation extension proposal, a reference instrumentation library, and a conformance checklist. This issue tracks only the reference-doc output.
